warnings: RESOLVES the อะเส (eave member) conflict flagged on หน้า16_view2 and หน้า21. This section prints 'อะเสเหล็ก C 150x50x20x3.2 มม.' -- a LIPPED CHANNEL with five numbers, agreeing with S-03's หมายเหตุ. S-08's จุดต่อ 5 detail is the only place it appears as a box section with three numbers. Two sheets to one, and both agreeing sheets state the full five-number lipped-channel form, so the CHANNEL reading is adopted per README's op1 precedence rule 3 (more sheets agreeing wins). The S-08 box label is treated as a drafting slip.

NEW MINOR CONFLICT found here: this section labels the toilet block's purlin 'แปเหล็ก C 100x50x20x3.2' while S-03's หมายเหตุ assigns the block the D profile, C125x50x20x3.2 @1.00 m. C100 is the MAIN building's A profile. One sheet each, so this is NOT resolved -- recorded as printed on each sheet and flagged. S-03 is the more specific source (it is the roof-framing sheet and names the mark), so a reviewer should prefer D unless the original drawing says otherwise.
'เสา คสล. 0.20x0.20 ม.' independently confirms the C-2 column size from S-05.
